summary: This is a Form 6-K submission by Wing Yip Food Holdings Group Limited, a Hong Kong-incorporated company, announcing its routine quarterly report filing with the Korea Exchange (KRX) for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a procedural requirement under KRX listing rules and does not involve any corporate transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special situation. No deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes are disclosed. The sole purpose is to update the market on the submission of quarterly financial statements. As a routine regulatory compliance filing, it does not trigger any special-situation classification under event-driven research criteria. The filing is treated as an equivalent to a foreign private issuer's current report on Form 6-K, carrying no actionable event for risk arbitrage.
